questions.stem: Which of the following is a biased sampling method?

options.text: Selecting every 10th person from a list
Using a random number generator to pick participants

questions.explanation: Surveying only your friends is biased because they are not representative of the whole population. A fair sample should be chosen randomly so that everyone has an equal chance of being selected.

questions.stem: A questionnaire asks: 'Don't you agree that homework is a waste of time?' This question is flawed because it is:
questions.explanation: The question is leading because it pushes the respondent toward agreeing. A fair question would be neutral, such as 'Do you think homework is useful?'.
